# Launch app (`app.launch`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Apps & scripts · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** no

Starts a program or opens a file.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | file path | yes |  | Program or file to open. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `arguments` | text | no |  | Command-line arguments. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `working_directory` | file path | no |  | Folder to start in. Defaults to the program's folder. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `window` | one of: `normal`, `minimized`, `maximized`, `hidden` | no | `normal` | Initial window state. |
| `skip_if_running` | true / false | no | `true` | Do nothing if the program is already running. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: app.launch
    path: C:\Program Files\OBS Studio\bin\64bit\obs64.exe
    working_directory: C:\Program Files\OBS Studio\bin\64bit
    window: minimized
```
